## How to Get Started

### Registration Process

1. Download the app from [Google Play Store (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.modernhealth.modernhealth) or [App Store (iOS)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/modern-health/id1445843859?ls=1), or visit [my.joinmodernhealth.com](https://my.joinmodernhealth.com)
2. Register with your GitLab email using your name as it appears in our system
3. Take the wellbeing assessment to get matched with appropriate resources
4. Connect with a coach or therapist based on your assessment results
